title: Angular
description: Gates for an Angular project tested with Vitest through the Angular builder, ng test. Each tool comes from the repo's node_modules, so its version is the one the lockfile pins.

gates.description: Runs the unit tests in a watch kept warm between turns, since ng test builds the whole application before a single test runs. At the stop, it waits for the watch to finish with the turn's changes, then fails on a build that does not compile, and on every red spec, the ones the change did not rerun included. The whole check runs ng test once, without a watch. The watch is asked for a cycle through tsconfig.spec.json, and starts again when a spec is created or deleted, since ng test lists its specs once. Angular 21 does not rebuild for a tsconfig: give its watch.sync a spec.

watch.cycleEnd: Test run finished with success|bundle generation failed

gates.description: Builds the application in a watch kept warm between turns, which type-checks every template, the ones of a component no spec reaches included: tsc alone never reads a template. At the stop, it fails on a build that does not compile, with the file and line of each error. Built without optimization into node_modules/.cache, so the dist of the project stays as it is. The whole check builds once, without a watch. The watch is asked for a cycle through src/main.ts.

Lints the changed templates with angular-eslint, warnings included: the lint of the TypeScript catalog reads no .html file. It needs an ESLint config that gives .html files to angular-eslint, such as its templateRecommended and templateAccessibility configs.

Fails on the strict template errors the turn added, never on the ones already there, for a project that turned strictTemplates off: it compiles the templates with strictTemplates and strictNullChecks forced on top of the project's options, through the API of the Angular compiler, so a binding that may be null is reported even when the TypeScript has strict errors of its own. The build gate checks the templates with the project's own options. An error is not new when moved, or reported with the same message in another file the turn did not change, or on a changed line as long as its file has no more errors of its code than at the turn start. It checks tsconfig.app.json: give its -p the tsconfig of the application.
